title: Ujian Kelulusan Akhir A2: 4-Skills CEFR A2 Graduation Exam
group: A2.3 - World Explorations, Stories & Bridge to B1
objective: Ujian kelulusan akhir CEFR A2 komprehensif 4 keterampilan (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking) untuk membuka Level B1

theory.summary: Ujian kelulusan ini menguji seluruh kemampuan bahasa Inggris level A2 kamu secara komprehensif. Kamu akan diuji dalam 4 keterampilan: mendengarkan (listening), membaca (reading), menulis dan tata bahasa (writing & grammar), serta berbicara (speaking). Ujian ini mencakup materi conditionals (first & second conditional), used to, relative clauses, phrasal verbs, kosakata tentang isu lingkungan, dan kemampuan bercerita panjang. Skor minimal untuk lulus adalah 75 dari 100. Setelah lulus, kamu siap melanjutkan ke level B1!
rules: First Conditional: If + present simple, will + infinitive. Digunakan untuk situasi nyata di masa depan. Contoh: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.
Second Conditional: If + past simple, would + infinitive. Digunakan untuk situasi hipotesis atau tidak nyata saat ini. Contoh: If I had more money, I would travel the world.
Used to: Used to + infinitive. Digunakan untuk kebiasaan di masa lalu yang sekarang tidak dilakukan lagi. Contoh: I used to play football every weekend when I was young.
Relative Clauses: Menggunakan who (orang), which (benda), that (orang/benda), where (tempat). Contoh: The book which I bought yesterday is very interesting.
Phrasal Verbs: Kombinasi kata kerja dengan preposisi/adverb yang membentuk makna baru. Contoh: look after (merawat), give up (menyerah), turn off (mematikan).

commonTrap.trapTitle: Peringatan Kesalahan Umum di Level A2
commonTrap.explanation: Siswa sering mencampuradukkan first dan second conditional, atau salah menggunakan 'used to' dengan 'be used to'. Perhatikan juga perbedaan waktu: first conditional untuk kemungkinan nyata (will), second conditional untuk imajinasi (would). Jangan lupa bahwa 'used to' diikuti infinitive tanpa 'to' tambahan.
commonTrap.wrong: If I would have time, I will visit you. I am used to play tennis.
commonTrap.correct: If I had time, I would visit you. I used to play tennis.

vocab.collocation: We need to protect the environment from pollution.
Our school recycles paper and plastic bottles every week.
I will graduate from A2 level after passing this exam.
Air pollution is a serious problem in big cities.
I used to live in the countryside before moving to the city.
Our journey to the mountains took five hours.
I'm visiting my relatives who live in London next month.
We should reduce waste by using reusable bags.
Plastic waste can destroy ocean life.
Passing this exam is a great achievement for you.

dialogue.context: Dua siswa, Maya dan Rudi, sedang berbicara setelah menyelesaikan ujian kelulusan A2 mereka. Mereka membahas soal ujian dan rencana belajar di level B1.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: How did you find the exam, Rudi?

lines.speaker: Rudi
lines.text: It was challenging! The listening part was quite difficult for me.
lines.translation: Cukup menantang! Bagian listening cukup sulit buat saya.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Really? I thought the reading comprehension was harder. What about the conditional questions?
lines.translation: Benarkah? Saya pikir reading comprehension lebih sulit. Bagaimana dengan soal conditional?

lines.speaker: Rudi
lines.text: Oh, those were okay. I used to struggle with second conditionals, but I practiced a lot.
lines.translation: Oh, itu oke. Dulu saya kesulitan dengan second conditional, tapi saya banyak latihan.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: That's great! If we pass this exam, we'll start B1 level next month.
lines.translation: Bagus sekali! Kalau kita lulus ujian ini, kita akan mulai level B1 bulan depan.

lines.speaker: Rudi
lines.text: I'm excited! I hope we both get more than 75. When will the results come out?
lines.translation: Saya bersemangat! Saya harap kita berdua dapat lebih dari 75. Kapan hasilnya keluar?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: The teacher said we'll get our scores tomorrow morning.
lines.translation: Guru bilang kita akan dapat nilai besok pagi.

lines.speaker: Rudi
lines.text: Perfect! Let's celebrate together if we pass!
lines.translation: Sempurna! Mari kita rayakan bersama kalau kita lulus!

speakingLab.context: Kamu sedang berbicara dengan Mr. Khoirul setelah menyelesaikan Ujian Kelulusan A2. Dia ingin mendengar refleksi kamu tentang pengalaman belajar di level A2 dan harapan kamu untuk level B1. Tunjukkan kemampuan speaking level A2 dengan menceritakan pengalaman belajar dan rencana masa depan.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Congratulations on completing your A2 graduation exam! How do you feel about it?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Khoirul! I feel nervous but also proud. The exam was quite challenging.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's completely normal! Which skill did you find most difficult during your A2 journey?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I think listening was the hardest for me. I used to struggle with understanding fast speakers, but I've improved a lot.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent progress! If you could give advice to new A2 students, what would you say?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I would tell them to practice every day and don't be afraid to make mistakes. Speaking practice really helped me.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's wonderful advice! What are you most excited about learning in B1 level?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I'm excited to learn more complex grammar and to have longer conversations. I also want to read more English books.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio transcript: 'Hi everyone, this is Sarah from Green Earth Organization. Today I want to talk about recycling. Many people don't know that if we recycle more plastic, we will help reduce ocean pollution. Last year, our community recycled 500 kilograms of plastic. This year, we hope to recycle even more. Remember, every bottle counts!' - According to Sarah, what will happen if we recycle more plastic?
options: We will create more pollution
We will help reduce ocean pollution
We will produce more plastic bottles
quiz.answer: We will help reduce ocean pollution
quiz.explanation: Dalam transkrip audio, Sarah dengan jelas menyatakan: 'if we recycle more plastic, we will help reduce ocean pollution.' Ini adalah contoh first conditional yang menunjukkan hasil nyata di masa depan dari tindakan recycle.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio transcript: 'When I was a child, I used to live in the countryside. My grandmother had a big farm with many animals. Every morning, I used to help her feed the chickens and collect eggs. I really miss those days. Now I live in the city, and everything is so different.' - What did the speaker do every morning in the past?
options: She helped feed the chickens and collect eggs
She played with her friends in the city
She went to school early
quiz.answer: She helped feed the chickens and collect eggs
quiz.explanation: Speaker menjelaskan kegiatan rutin masa lalunya dengan 'used to': 'Every morning, I used to help her feed the chickens and collect eggs.' Ini menunjukkan kebiasaan masa lalu yang sekarang tidak lagi dilakukan.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio transcript: 'This is the weather forecast for tomorrow. If it rains in the morning, we will cancel the outdoor football match. However, if the weather is sunny, the match will start at 10 AM in the stadium. Please check your phone for updates tomorrow morning.' - What will happen if it rains tomorrow morning?
options: The match will start earlier
The outdoor football match will be cancelled
The match will be played indoors
quiz.answer: The outdoor football match will be cancelled
quiz.explanation: Pembicara menggunakan first conditional: 'If it rains in the morning, we will cancel the outdoor football match.' Ini menjelaskan konsekuensi nyata jika kondisi hujan terjadi besok.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio transcript: 'I'm looking for the person who called me yesterday about the English course. Was it you? I remember the voice was very friendly. The person said they wanted to join the B1 class which starts next month. If you're that person, please reply to this message!' - Who is the speaker looking for?
options: The person who called about the English course
The person who teaches the B1 class
The person who started the course last month
quiz.answer: The person who called about the English course
quiz.explanation: Speaker menggunakan relative clause 'who called me yesterday about the English course' untuk mendeskripsikan orang yang dia cari. 'Who' digunakan untuk merujuk kepada orang (person).

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Read the text: 'Emma used to work in a big city, but she wasn't happy. The pollution was terrible, and she never had time to relax. Two years ago, she decided to move to a small village in the countryside. Now she works from home and enjoys the fresh air. She says, "If I hadn't moved here, I would still be stressed and unhappy." Emma believes that her decision to move was the best thing she ever did.' - Why did Emma move to the countryside?
options: Because she wanted to work in a bigger office
Because she wasn't happy with city life and pollution
Because her family lived there
quiz.answer: Because she wasn't happy with city life and pollution
quiz.explanation: Teks menyebutkan: 'she wasn't happy. The pollution was terrible, and she never had time to relax.' Emma pindah karena tidak bahagia dengan kehidupan kota dan masalah polusi. Ini menunjukkan alasan perpindahannya.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Read the text: 'The Amazon rainforest is a place which is very important for our planet. It produces 20% of the world's oxygen. However, many trees are being cut down every day. Scientists say that if we don't protect the Amazon, climate change will get worse. We need to take action now to save this incredible ecosystem that millions of animals call home.' - According to the text, what will happen if we don't protect the Amazon?
options: It will produce more oxygen
Climate change will get worse
More animals will live there
quiz.explanation: Teks dengan jelas menyatakan first conditional: 'if we don't protect the Amazon, climate change will get worse.' Ini menunjukkan konsekuensi nyata dari tidak melindungi hutan Amazon.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Read the text: 'My neighbor is a woman who travels around the world teaching English. She has visited 30 countries so far. Last week, she told me about a school in Thailand where she taught for two years. She said, "If I could choose, I would live in Thailand forever. The people are so friendly!" She used to be afraid of flying, but now she loves it.' - What is true about the neighbor?
options: She still fears flying
She has visited 30 countries and used to be afraid of flying
She has never been to Thailand
quiz.answer: She has visited 30 countries and used to be afraid of flying
quiz.explanation: Teks menyebutkan: 'She has visited 30 countries' dan 'She used to be afraid of flying, but now she loves it.' Kombinasi fakta ini menunjukkan perubahan dari masa lalu (takut terbang) ke sekarang (suka terbang) setelah banyak bepergian.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Read the text: 'Plastic waste is one of the biggest environmental problems today. A plastic bag which you use for 10 minutes can take 500 years to decompose. Many countries are now trying to reduce plastic use. In my city, shops give customers reusable bags. If everyone used reusable bags, we would save millions of plastic bags every year. It's a small change that can make a big difference.' - What does the relative clause 'which you use for 10 minutes' refer to?
options: Environmental problems
A plastic bag
Many countries
quiz.explanation: Relative clause 'which you use for 10 minutes' merujuk pada 'A plastic bag' yang disebutkan sebelumnya. 'Which' digunakan untuk benda (plastic bag), bukan orang. Klausa ini memberikan informasi tambahan tentang kantong plastik.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Choose the grammatically correct sentence using second conditional:
options: If I have more money, I will buy a new car
If I had more money, I would buy a new car
If I will have more money, I would buy a new car
quiz.answer: If I had more money, I would buy a new car
quiz.explanation: Second conditional menggunakan struktur: If + past simple, would + infinitive. Digunakan untuk situasi hipotesis atau tidak nyata saat ini. 'If I had' (past simple) + 'I would buy' (would + infinitive) adalah struktur yang benar untuk mengekspresikan situasi imajiner.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Complete the sentence with the correct form: 'I ___ to play video games every day, but now I prefer reading books.'
options: am used
used
use
quiz.explanation: 'Used to' digunakan untuk menyatakan kebiasaan di masa lalu yang sekarang tidak lagi dilakukan. Strukturnya: subject + used to + infinitive. Jadi kalimat lengkapnya: 'I used to play video games every day, but now I prefer reading books.'

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Choose the sentence with the correct relative clause:
options: The teacher which teaches us English is very patient
The teacher who teaches us English is very patient
The teacher where teaches us English is very patient
quiz.answer: The teacher who teaches us English is very patient
quiz.explanation: 'Who' digunakan untuk merujuk pada orang (people). Karena 'the teacher' adalah orang, maka relative pronoun yang benar adalah 'who', bukan 'which' (untuk benda) atau 'where' (untuk tempat).

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Identify the correct phrasal verb to complete: 'Please ___ the lights when you leave the room to save electricity.'
options: turn off
turn on
turn up
quiz.explanation: 'Turn off' adalah phrasal verb yang berarti mematikan (lampu, alat elektronik, dll). Konteks kalimat menunjukkan tindakan mematikan lampu untuk menghemat listrik saat meninggalkan ruangan. 'Turn on' berarti menyalakan, dan 'turn up' berarti menaikkan volume.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] Your friend asks: 'What would you do if you won a million dollars?' The best A2-level response is:
options: I would travel around the world and help my family
I win the lottery tomorrow and buy everything
If I will win, I would be happy
quiz.answer: I would travel around the world and help my family
quiz.explanation: Pertanyaan menggunakan second conditional (What would you do if you won...?), maka jawaban juga harus menggunakan second conditional: 'I would + infinitive.' Jawaban ini gramatikal benar dan menunjukkan respon natural level A2 terhadap situasi hipotesis.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] Someone says: 'I used to live in Jakarta.' The most appropriate follow-up question is:
options: Why did you move? Where do you live now?
Do you still live there now?
When will you move to Jakarta?
quiz.answer: Why did you move? Where do you live now?
quiz.explanation: Ketika seseorang mengatakan 'I used to live in Jakarta,' itu berarti mereka tidak lagi tinggal di sana. Follow-up question yang natural adalah menanyakan alasan pindah dan tempat tinggal sekarang. Ini menunjukkan pemahaman tentang 'used to' dan kemampuan melanjutkan percakapan dengan tepat.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] At a job interview, the interviewer asks: 'Can you tell me about a person who influenced you?' You should respond:
options: My teacher who helped me learn English influenced me a lot
The person which taught me was good
I influenced by many people in my life
quiz.answer: My teacher who helped me learn English influenced me a lot
quiz.explanation: Respons ini menggunakan relative clause dengan benar ('who' untuk orang), struktur grammar yang tepat, dan menjawab pertanyaan secara natural. Ini menunjukkan kemampuan speaking level A2 dalam situasi formal seperti interview.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] Your classmate says: 'If the weather is nice tomorrow, what shall we do?' The best response showing first conditional understanding is:
options: If it's sunny, we can go to the park or have a picnic
If it will be nice, we would go outside
We will going to the beach if weather nice
quiz.answer: If it's sunny, we can go to the park or have a picnic
quiz.explanation: Pertanyaan menggunakan first conditional (If the weather is nice...), jadi respons yang tepat juga menggunakan first conditional: 'If it's sunny (present simple), we can go (modal + infinitive).' Respons ini gramatikal benar, natural, dan menunjukkan kemampuan merespon ajakan dengan conditional.
